$comment: Warden seat permission profile (backported from Proofdelve 21f.1, Farlantern). Loaded by fort/scripts/warden.sh with --setting-sources '' so this file is the ONLY permission source. The launcher also restricts the tool set to Bash,Read,Grep,Glob (no Edit/Write/Task), sets cwd to a scratch copy, and adds the checkout(s) via --add-dir. The seat has ZERO write permissions: the launcher records the verdict (bd comment --file from the session log) and emits the review.verdict event. IMPORTANT, verified 2026-08-03: commands absent from the allow list are NOT reliably denied — Claude Code's built-in classifier auto-allows some read-only commands (sed ran; awk and python failed shut; mutating forms like sed -i and redirection were refused). Treat the allow list as convenience, the deny list as the boundary, and assume unknown read-only commands may run. Hence the broad Bash(*.env*) deny; obfuscated-path reads are a known limit (Proofdelve 21f.8): deny globs bind a spelling, not a file. Deny globs match the whole command line INCLUDING quoted arguments — prose containing a denied pattern trips the rule.
